original_test_intent: Verify the canonical SMBIOS Type 3 Security Status enumeration for the intended enclosure matches the approved platform state and persists after reboot. The repeated wording names the System Enclosure or Chassis Security Status field, not multiple independent values.
original_method: Capture full Type 3 records, bind the target enclosure by identity/BOM, parse raw and decoded Security Status, compare with the approved value or explicitly supported unknown/other state, reboot and repeat without opening the chassis or triggering intrusion.
manual_activity: A user approves the canonical field, expected/unsupported-state policy and reboot plan. The metadata read and comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Approved mapping to canonical Type 3 Security Status
Expected raw/decoded state and Unknown/Other handling
Validated dmidecode/transport and controlled evidence path
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not open the chassis, trigger intrusion sensors, alter security settings or modify firmware.
Preserve complete Type 3 output and raw enum; do not treat empty literal-grep output as evidence.
Keep security-state evidence access-controlled where project policy requires it.
Do not conflate this static field with live chassis-intrusion sensor state or invent multiple status fields.
Stop on ambiguity, unexpected security state, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect all Type 3 structures, select the enclosure, parse canonical Security Status and compare raw/decoded values before/after reboot.
Do not trigger intrusion, change security state, modify DMI or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve field semantics, expected/unsupported enum policy and enclosure mapping.
Decide separate intrusion-sensor functional coverage and issue the metadata-case verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not applicable as written because the duplicated descriptive phrase is not the canonical output label; it also suppresses errors and lacks record/enum provenance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the source wording, archive complete Type 3 output/tool/errors and parse the selected enclosure's canonical `Security Status` raw and decoded enum.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The exact source label, Type 3 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.status: CONTROLLED TYPE 3 SECURITY STATUS ENUM CHECK
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve the item text to one canonical Security Status field, compare raw and decoded enums for the mapped enclosure under an explicit Unknown/Other policy, and retain controlled before/after evidence without intrusion stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode, BIOS, chassis and BOM revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 3 Chassis Security Status enumeration and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects extraction, formalizes unsupported-state handling and prevents expansion into physical security testing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction to metadata scope; intrusion sensor functionality remains separate.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected enum policy and enclosure mapping.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Static firmware metadata may not reflect current BMC intrusion telemetry.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a supported Unknown/Other state for an enclosure that does not implement the field, but must retain the raw enum and cannot claim intrusion-sensor behavior from this metadata check.
expected_evidence: Approval, canonical mapping, expected/unsupported Security Status policy, enclosure mapping and tool/SMBIOS versions
Complete controlled pre-reboot Type 3 record plus raw/decoded security-state comparison
Engineer verdict and separate intrusion-test reference if applicable
